templates.why_chosen: Stacked (a) naive PCIe-update / (b) packet-driven ZooRoute panels share the same Programmable ASIC anchor box and hash table, with a right-side legend for the gold delivered-by-packet line and only (b) carrying circled steps.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack a simple baseline over the richer mechanism, keeping the outer ASIC boundary identical in both; but number both panels' steps, not just one, since numbering only the proposed half (as here) makes the comparison feel lopsided, and crop tightly so no neighbouring figure bleeds in.
